caption: A source direction is filtered by the head and pinna (the HRTF), producing left and right ear signals that contain ITD, ILD and spectral notches; headphones replay them and the listener perceives one direction.

spec.title: From source to perceived direction
spec.aria: A source direction passes through the head and pinna, then the HRTF filter, which creates two ear signals containing interaural time difference, interaural level difference and spectral notches; headphones replay the two signals and the listener perceives one direction.

nodes.label: Left ear signal: ITD, ILD, notches
Right ear signal: ITD, ILD, notches
